notes: Measurements performed with the Li-ion battery disconnected; ground reference was the battery B− contact verified continuous with USB-C shell.
M− to ground measured approximately 35 MΩ; M+ to ground approximately 2.1 kΩ while unpowered. Meter readings are not independent resistor-value measurements.
Continuity indicates connector M− is on the same net as one end of R1L and C1L; M+ is on the same net as one end of R1R and C1R.
The other R1L terminal joins C0 terminal 2. The other R1R terminal joins C0 terminal 1 AND verified ground. Do not reinterpret C0 as bridging two floating differential lines.
The non-M+ side of C1R leads to a nearby capacitor, vias and an accessible JieLi chip contact. We call that contact JL-A until the exact pinout is available.
The non-M− side of C1L has not been fully traced. Small-component values and the exact AC7006 variant remain unknown.
Net names and arbitrary terminal indices in this JSON are reverse-engineering labels, not manufacturer pin identifiers; the drawing is not proof of the IC's internal audio architecture.
